translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Paila tokugwa ekalesia
Biga baisa bigala goli mokwita
- kidamwa avai tau iiyamwasi mwada igau bikau tokugwa ekalesia la guyau, matauna magila la wotetila saina kwevakaigaga.
Paila tokugwa ekalesia ibodi gala bisim pikolela wowola. Gala ibodi bivilayawa,
bikudibwaila, gala tokwatudewa matauna, e bininatala; ibodi bivakawoli mitawasi ola valu; ibodi bikabitutuki vituloki;
gala ibodi matauna tomom waini kaipeula, kaina tokominimani; mitaga tomanum deli tobigabwaila. Gala ibodi biyebwaili mani.
Ibodi la bwala tatoula kala tosisu biyamati bwaina, deli litula bikabikuwolaisi deli bikamiabaisi matauna.
Paila kidamwa matauna gala ikikateta ammakawala biyamati availa availa matausina eivauli bibwaina, e ammakawala matauna bivigaki kidamwa biyamati la ekalesia Yaubada?
Gala ibodi bukunagaisi availa toekalesia tovau kaina igau bikaiveka nanola deli biyouloveka la kaluvalova e biboda kala kamwaga, makawala goli Diabolo.
E ibodi bukunagaisi avai tau tosipayumila ikikamiabaisi mwada taga biboda kala kalawou e biwai okala sikula Diabolo.
Paila ekalesia kala towotetila
Makawala goli ekalesia kala towotetila deli, ibodi matausina bibubunasi bwainawokuva kidamwa kasi vatusi bimilakatila; gala bibodi matausina bimomsi waini sainela, kaina bigugovekasi.
Ibodi matausina bikatetasi uvagila tapwaroru kwemomwau deli ninasi kala mimilakatila.
Ikugwa ibodi bukuwakolaisi, e kidamwa bogwa bipeulasi, bwaina wala ibodi biwotetilasi.
E ekalesia kala towotetila si kukova
deli, ibodi bibubunasi bwaina, e taga bisilapulusi; ibodi tuvaila avaka avaka bivagaisi, gala nakatudewa, e nakamokwita minasina.
E ekalesia kala towotetila gala ibodi bivilayawa,
e gagabila biyamati litula deli la ula bibwaina.
E towotetila matausina, availa availa itobwabwailasi bogwa bitomatalasi deli gagabila bilivalasi tuvaluwa, paila dubumi makwaina avaka talumkolaisi okala vasosu Keriso Yesu.
Ka, tapwaroru uvagila kala katupwana
Baisa tuta laginigini miyana m leta, e lapikwakwaim makateki bawokaiam kidamwa deli bitakayakusi.

Mitaga kaina bayobali. E kidamwa makawala, miyana leta biyoluluwaiyaim avaka avaka bibodaidasi yakidasi Yaubada la tomota. E boda makwaina bitadokaisi Yaubada Tomomova la ekalesia; e mabudona ekalesia baisa biga kwekamokwita kala kokola deli kala kalidaga.
E gala availa bininayuwa, da tapwarorusi uvagila kwemomwau kala katupwana saina vakaigaga.
